verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a reasonable thing to ask of a banking API, but the evidence pack documents no batch or bulk endpoint, such as bulk transfer creation or bulk account or card actions. Transfers are made one at a time with single `POST /ach_transfers` or `POST /wire_transfers` calls. The "batch processing" mention refers only to reading Events through the List Events API, an adjacent read pattern rather than a bulk-action capability. Creating many account numbers or cards through repeated API calls is a developer building block, not a documented bulk-operation feature.
